name: uwu-code
description: Super duper kawaii VS Code: pastel themes, sakura petals behind your code, sparkle bursts on save, gutter hearts, error kaomoji and a status-bar mascot ♡

uwu.petals.enabled.description: Show sakura petals drifting behind the code in the editor.

uwu.petals.opacity.description: How visible the petals are (0 = invisible, 1 = full).

enumDescriptions: Keep the petals out of the code: invisible over the first ~24 text columns, fading in to full strength past ~72 columns (default)
Petals across the whole editor, behind the code too
uwu.petals.area.description: Where the petals show up in the editor.

enumDescriptions: All three layers, including big soft petals up front (heavier: costs some frame rate on slower machines)
Near and far petals (default, smooth everywhere)
Only the small, slow far-away petals (subtlest and lightest)

uwu.sparkleOnSave.description: Burst hearts and sparkles at the cursor when you save.

uwu.gutterHearts.description: Show a little heart in the gutter on lines you changed since the last save.

uwu.errorKaomoji.description: Show a sad kaomoji at the end of lines with errors.

uwu.mascot.description: Show a kaomoji mascot in the status bar that reacts to errors and saves.

colors.description: Colour of the error kaomoji shown after lines with errors.
